title: S1 sdet-architect scoped-analysis findings
description: Output of the S1 sdet_architect scoped-analysis mode: inferred testing conventions + best-practice gaps scoped to a blast radius (impacted symbols + sampled tests). Consumed by the S2 test_maintainer proposer to guide update/add edits toward house style.

schema_version.description: Schema version — always '1.0' for this release.

conventions.description: Inferred testing conventions from the sampled existing tests.

layout.description: Test directory layout convention (e.g. 'tests/ mirroring src/', 'co-located __tests__/', 'src/test/java/').

naming.description: Naming convention for test functions/methods/classes (e.g. 'test_<thing>_<condition>' for pytest, 'should_<verb>When<Condition>' for JUnit, 'describe/it' for jest).

fixture_mock_idioms.description: Observed fixture and mock idioms (e.g. '@pytest.fixture', 'jest.fn()', 'Mockito.mock()', 'factories via conftest.py').

extra.description: Optional stack-specific or project-specific observations beyond the five standard fields.

gaps.description: Best-practice gaps scoped to the blast radius (impacted symbols/tests). Each gap describes a missing test scenario or test smell that S2 should close with an 'add' proposal or flag as 'Needs human attention'.

symbol.description: The changed/new symbol (function, method, or class) this gap applies to.

gap_type.description: Category of gap: missing_negative_test (no error/exception path), missing_edge_case (boundary / empty input), untested_symbol (no test reaches this symbol), test_smell (brittle / unclear / high-maintenance test pattern), missing_contract_test (cross-service boundary not covered), other.

description.description: One or two sentence description of the gap and what a closing test should cover.

suggested_test_name.description: Optional: a suggested test function/method name following the repo's naming convention.
